Krea 2 Surprise-Me Entity Sheets - Type-Safe Ref2VA Ready

Click Run once to queue four independently randomised sheets. Rows 1-2 select only people or genuinely humanoid characters and use the nine-panel face/body/T-pose layout. Rows 3-4 select animals, creatures, vehicles, buildings, food, furniture, tools, machines and props and use the six-panel turnaround layout. Disable any row you do not want.

  1. Leave Prompt Multi in Queue mode. Its four marker-only rows deliberately choose the safe route.
  2. The two orange director boxes contain the live Pixaroma tags. Every *Category selects a random ten-choice list, then a line; every #tag selects one random line from a specific list.
  3. Edit or extend the four Codex... List categories in Pixaroma Tag Library. All 54 lists contain exactly ten choices.
  4. Optionally choose one Krea 2 LoRA in the shared Pixaroma LoRA Loader. It is OFF by default; when enabled, its model, CLIP and trigger words apply to every queued sheet.
  5. The marker expander inserts exactly one route. Objects never receive face, full-body or T-pose instructions.
  6. Load the resulting PNGs into Ref2VA as ref_image_0, ref_image_1, and so on.

Expanded pools: 100 poseable character bases, 200 complete non-humanoid/entity bases, 120 compatible character-trait choices and 120 item-trait choices. The automatic object route uses only the 60 type-neutral item traits; the more class-specific 60 remain available for optional manual experiments.
